paragraphs: I'm applying for the Financial Analyst role in New York. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) student at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. I like that this role works across retail stores, e-commerce and wholesale and reports into the CFO and COO, so the analysis actually drives decisions.

At JPMorgan I built models to evaluate $10M in marketing-channel budget allocation and benchmarked past allocations to find 30% efficiency gains. At Lenovo I built forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and dashboards that pulled financial projections and predictive metrics together. At Thomson Reuters I supported monthly P&L forecasting, variance analysis and close.

That maps to the budgets, forecasts, channel profitability reporting and month-end work in the posting. I'm comfortable pulling data from several systems, cleaning it, and turning it into a short story for leadership. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
